name: mlflow-qa
description: Small golden set for MLflow documentation Q&A evaluation.

samples.expected_output: MLflow Tracking logs parameters, metrics, and artifacts for ML experiments.
reference_contexts: MLflow Tracking is a component of MLflow that logs parameters, code versions, metrics, and output files.

samples.input: How do you log a metric in MLflow?
samples.expected_output: Use mlflow.log_metric(name, value) to log a metric.
reference_contexts: mlflow.log_metric logs a single key-value metric. The key is a string and the value is a number.

samples.expected_output: mlflow.evaluate runs evaluation on a model or pipeline and computes configured metrics.
reference_contexts: The mlflow.evaluate API evaluates models and LLM applications, computing built-in and custom metrics.

reference_contexts: Set the MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI environment variable to point to a remote tracking server.
